镇守于封魔之地的强大领主，只存在于故事书中的高贵古龙，大陆最古老最强大的生灵，即: The powerful lord guarding the Forbidden Lands, a noble ancient dragon known only in storybooks, the oldest and most powerful creature on the continent. Though rarely seen, it remains the most threatening enemy to kingdoms and the Adventurer's Guild. The Adventurer's Guild maintains few records of the ancient dragons, but the story of the Chaos Dragon is told in the bard's storybooks: [O great being that sleeps within the spirit veins... please hear my wish, cast away all your inner anxiety, and rest in the embrace of nature.] [Goddess Tina gently strokes the Chaos Dragon's forehead, then sings a ballad before disappearing beside the ancient dragon. From then on, the ancient dragon ceases its tormented slumber and soars high in the sky, returning to its spirit veins only to rest when a rainbow appears in the sky...]
镇守于森林迷宫的强大领主，是狼族魔物们不可质疑的“头狼”。<br>在迷宫之外也曾: The powerful lord guarding the forest maze is the undisputed "alpha" of the wolf monsters. Outside the maze, rumors of the Scarlet Flame Wolf King have spread. He guards a vast forest and represents the wolf race. If an adventurer attempts to subjugate a wolf in this forest, he will arrive amidst the full moon and the howling of wolves. In a duel, he will teach the adventurer the price he will pay, leaving a mark of his fire magic on the field. Generally, the Adventurer's Guild doesn't post requests to subjugate the Scarlet Flame Wolf King on the bulletin board. After all, the Scarlet Flame Wolf King poses a threat comparable to that of the dragons that inhabit the mountains, requiring a truly powerful hero to stand a chance against him.
镇守于沙漠的强大领主，是王国百年来记载的守护圣兽。<br>圣兽格里芬是王国的古代: The powerful lord guarding the desert is the kingdom's centuries-old guardian beast. The Griffin is an ancient sacred beast of the kingdom. Legend has it that in times of danger for the royal city, the beast descends from the sky and uses powerful wind magic to drive the enemy from the land. The beast's arrival often brings a powerful hurricane, a warning to invaders and a clarion call for the kingdom's army to strike back. While dust storms are common in the desert, the constant sandstorms within the labyrinth are perhaps the work of the Griffin. However, what caused it to abandon the mountains, where wind magic is most abundant, and choose to inhabit such a harsh environment remains unknown.
镇守于矿洞的强大领主，不知道是什么时代的魔法傀儡，一旦激活则有摧毁山岭的力量。<: A powerful lord guarding the mines, a magical golem from an unknown era, possesses the power to destroy mountains once activated. Magic golems are frequently used in wars. These golems are powerful, loyal, brave, and incapable of fear. Their thirst for victory has led to rapid advancements in magic golem technology, culminating in the creation of a Titan that can easily destroy a castle. With the war's end, the golems were abandoned, gradually blending seamlessly into their surroundings, becoming part of the historical relic. However, the "core" that powered the Titan remains healthy. Rather than abandoned, it awaits the next war, the next battlefield...
镇守于雪原的强大领主，是迷宫外冰雪遗迹墙面刻画的强大魔兽。<br>幻影鹿王并非什: The powerful lord guarding the snowfields is a formidable beast depicted on the walls of the icy ruins outside the labyrinth. The Phantom Deer King isn't some mysterious beast; any ruin associated with ice and snow will inevitably feature murals and depictions of it. Some formidable adventurers have even battled its phantoms within the ruins' treasure chambers, only to be surrounded by them one after another, forcing them to retreat. Even outside the labyrinth, no one knows the origins of these Phantom Deer King phantoms, let alone their true strength. All they know is that they are one with the ice and snow, and even if they temporarily triumph, they will return time and again.
